levels.title: Absolute Beginner
levels.description: Greetings, introductions, essential phrases, numbers and simple questions.
levels.speakingGoal: Say a greeting, introduce yourself, ask someone's name and answer a basic question.

levels.title: Everyday Conversations
levels.description: Family, food, shopping, prices, directions, time and daily routines.
levels.speakingGoal: Handle short, predictable daily interactions using simple sentences.

levels.title: Building Sentences
levels.description: Present, past and future patterns, negation, questions and polite requests.
levels.speakingGoal: Form your own sentences instead of relying only on memorised phrases.

levels.title: Natural Social Urdu
levels.description: Invitations, plans, feelings, opinions and casual expressions.
levels.speakingGoal: Hold several connected exchanges and respond more naturally.

levels.title: Real-World Communication
levels.description: Travel, phone calls, work, explaining problems and fixing misunderstandings.
levels.speakingGoal: Explain what you need, ask follow-up questions and recover when a conversation gets difficult.

levels.title: Advanced Conversational Practice
levels.description: Idioms, storytelling, connected speech and nuanced opinions.
levels.speakingGoal: Keep longer conversations going with fewer hints and less English.

story.title: Summer in Lahore
story.text: You've just landed in Lahore to spend the summer with your Khala's family. Your cousin Bilal, his sister Ayesha, little Zara and Dada ji can't wait to meet you — but at home, everyone speaks Urdu. Leni, your teacher, will help you every step of the way.
